messages:
Alex (Customer Success): FYI customer (Acme Enterprise) reported billing on hold — procurement says they will not accept an invoice unless we have a signed PO that matches the contract id. customer provided procurement@acme-enterprise.com as contact.
Maya Chen: copying billing queue. do we have their PO on file or a field for that in the billing system?
Billing Bot: Invoice attempt failed: reason=PO_REQUIRED, account_id=acct_01A9X, invoice_id=draft_2026_331.
Santiago Ruiz: Can we attach a PO number to the draft invoice and reissue? Iirc our invoicing API supports purchase_order field.
Maya Chen: if they need a signed PO before invoice issuance, finance/legal usually want the PO attached and acknowledgement email. can ops create a draft invoice with PO and hold sending until compliance confirms?
Olivia Park: Suggested next steps: 1) Confirm PO number + signed doc from customer; 2) Create draft invoice with purchase_order set; 3) Send PO acknowledgement email template and cc finance. I'll paste the email template below.
Olivia Park: Email template snippet: "Dear [Procurement], we confirm receipt of PO #[PO_NUMBER] against Contract [CONTRACT_ID]. We will issue an invoice referencing the PO once you confirm signature on your side."
Santiago Ruiz: Quick repro for attaching PO via API (billing microservice):
```
POST /v1/accounts/acct_01A9X/invoices
{
  "amount": 125000,
  "currency": "USD",
  "description": "Reserved capacity - April",
  "purchase_order": "PO-7782-AE",
  "metadata": { "contract_id": "C-2025-112" }
}
```
Maya Chen: thanks. Finance (J. Patel) — can you confirm whether we can issue the invoice as draft and then send a PDF referencing PO-7782-AE?
Finance (J. Patel): we can. we need: 1) signed PO PDF attached to the invoice record, 2) PO number in the invoice header, and 3) a short acknowledgement email from us. once attached we can mark invoice as ready to send.
Alex (Customer Success): I've asked procurement to upload the signed PO to the secure portal and sent them the exact filename format they should use. they said it may take 48 hours.
Santiago Ruiz: temp workaround if they won't upload: we can accept a scanned PDF emailed to procurement@redwood-invoice (secure email) and operations will attach it manually — but legal prefers portal.
Maya Chen: logging this as ticket #SUP-5932 and tagging billing ops. I'll set a 48h follow-up. :thumbsup:
Alex (Customer Success): noted. will update thread once procurement confirms. thanks all.
Billing Bot: follow-up reminder scheduled in 48h for ticket SUP-5932.
